species: rat (primary cortical neurons from fetal rats); mouse (C57Bl/6/C3H)
readout_other: LC3B immunofluorescence; LC3BII/LC3BI and p62 western blot; c-Fos immunofluorescence; H&E and Nissl histology
direction_notes: LIPUS increased LC3B expression in cultured neurons (with duration and intensity), raised c-Fos and the LC3BII/LC3BI ratio and lowered p62 in mouse cortex and hippocampus, indicating induced autophagy.
safety_notes: H&E and Nissl staining after 4 h LIPUS showed no hemorrhage, tissue damage or neuron loss in cortex and CA1; the Discussion states stimulation did not cause temperature rise.

timing.protocol_description: Sonication duration of 1 s, interstimulus interval of 1 s, duty cycle 5%, PRF 500 Hz, delivered through the bottom of the culture chamber in a 37 C incubator for 4 or 6 h.

Sonication duration of 1 s, interstimulus interval of 1 s, duty cycle 5%, PRF 500 Hz, transcranially for 4 h (40 min for the c-Fos experiment). Sham mice had the same treatment with the ultrasound switched off.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-eight adult C57Bl/6/C3H mice (seven months) were randomly divided into sham $~ ( n ~ = ~ 1 4 )$ and LIPUS $( n ~ = ~ 1 4 )$ groups.
